item.title: What is the Future of TIL Therapy in Metastatic Melanoma?
item.description: Muhammad Umair Mushtaq, MD, discussed the evolution of TIL therapy in melanoma, focusing on first-line treatment potential.

item.title: cemiplimab Data in Cutaneous Squamous Cell Carcinoma
item.description: cemiplimab shows durable responses in advanced cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (cSCC) in phase 2 study.
